title: CockroachDB Active Session History (ASH)
description: Real-time visualization of CockroachDB Active Session History (ASH)

links.title: Job Detail
links.tooltip: Drill into background job resource consumption

options.content:
### CockroachDB Active Session History (ASH)
CockroachDB v26.2 introduces **Active Session History** — a lightweight, always-on sampling system (1 sample/sec/session) that captures what every session is doing.

**Work Event Type Colors**: CPU (green) · IO (blue) · LOCK (red) · NETWORK (yellow) · ADMISSION (orange) · OTHER (purple)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT app_name) AS value FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND workload_type = 'STATEMENT' AND coalesce(app_name, '') != '' AND app_name NOT LIKE '$ %'
SELECT round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'LOCK') * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time)

SELECT round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'ADMISSION') * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time)

panels.title: Active Sessions by Work Event Type
panels.description: Stacked area of work event types over time. Stacked bottom-to-top: OTHER, ADMISSION, NETWORK, LOCK, IO, CPU. Click a legend item to isolate a series.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('second', sample_time) AS time, work_event_type AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'CPU') AS "CPU", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'IO') AS "IO", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'LOCK') AS "LOCK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'NETWORK') AS "NETWORK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'ADMISSION') AS "ADMISSION", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'OTHER') AS "OTHER" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time)

panels.title: CPU Event Breakdown
panels.description: Top CPU sub-events broken down by workload type: user statements, background jobs, and system work.

targets.rawSql: SELECT work_event, count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'STATEMENT') AS "STATEMENT", count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'JOB') AS "JOB", count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'SYSTEM') AS "SYSTEM" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND work_event_type = 'CPU' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: IO Event Breakdown
panels.description: Top IO sub-events broken down by workload type: user statements, background jobs, and system work.

targets.rawSql: SELECT work_event, count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'STATEMENT') AS "STATEMENT", count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'JOB') AS "JOB", count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'SYSTEM') AS "SYSTEM" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND work_event_type = 'IO' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: NETWORK Event Breakdown
panels.description: Top NETWORK sub-events broken down by workload type: user statements, background jobs, and system work.

targets.rawSql: SELECT work_event, count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'STATEMENT') AS "STATEMENT", count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'JOB') AS "JOB", count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'SYSTEM') AS "SYSTEM" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND work_event_type = 'NETWORK' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top Work Events by Workload Type
panels.description: Top 10 work events across all types, broken down by workload type (STATEMENT, JOB, SYSTEM).

targets.rawSql: SELECT work_event_type || ': ' || work_event AS work_event, count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'STATEMENT') AS "STATEMENT", count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'JOB') AS "JOB", count(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_type = 'SYSTEM') AS "SYSTEM" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: STATEMENT vs JOB vs SYSTEM
panels.description: CockroachDB-unique: separates user SQL, background jobs, and internal system work. Stacked view — click legend to isolate a series.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('second', sample_time) AS time, workload_type AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Samples by Application
panels.description: Which applications are consuming the most resources? Stacked by work event type.

targets.rawSql: SELECT app_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'CPU') AS "CPU", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'IO') AS "IO", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'LOCK') AS "LOCK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'NETWORK') AS "NETWORK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'ADMISSION') AS "ADMISSION", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'OTHER') AS "OTHER" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND workload_type = 'STATEMENT' AND coalesce(app_name, '') != '' AND app_name NOT LIKE '$ %' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Active Sessions by Node Over Time
panels.description: Shows WHEN a node got hot — not just totals. Look for temporal spikes that the aggregate bar chart can't show.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('second', sample_time) AS time, 'Node ' || node_id::TEXT AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Per-Node Work Event Distribution
panels.description: Per-node aggregate breakdown by work event type. Compare nodes to identify imbalance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Node ' || node_id::TEXT AS node, count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'CPU') AS "CPU", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'IO') AS "IO", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'LOCK') AS "LOCK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'NETWORK') AS "NETWORK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'ADMISSION') AS "ADMISSION", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'OTHER') AS "OTHER" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) GROUP BY node_id ORDER BY node_id

panels.title: Lock Contention by App & Event
panels.description: LOCK work_events: LockWait, LatchWait, TxnPushWait, TxnQueryWait. Click a row to drill down.

targets.rawSql: SELECT work_event, app_name, count(*) AS samples, round(count(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 1) AS pct FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND work_event_type = 'LOCK' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY samples DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Application × Node Heatmap
panels.description: Which application is hammering which node? High sample counts indicate hotspots.

targets.rawSql: SELECT app_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE node_id = 1) AS "Node 1", count(*) FILTER (WHERE node_id = 2) AS "Node 2", count(*) FILTER (WHERE node_id = 3) AS "Node 3", count(*) AS "Total" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND workload_type = 'STATEMENT' AND coalesce(app_name, '') != '' AND app_name NOT LIKE '$ %' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Lock Contention Drill-Down: Statements
panels.description: Shows which SQL statements are experiencing lock waits. Click a row to see full lock detail.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(substring(ss.query, 1, 120), 'fingerprint: ' || ash.workload_id) AS query_preview, ash.app_name, ash.work_event, count(*) AS lock_samples, round(count(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 1) AS pct FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history ash LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (fingerprint_id) fingerprint_id, metadata->>'query' AS query FROM crdb_internal.statement_statistics ORDER BY fingerprint_id) ss ON ash.workload_id = encode(ss.fingerprint_id, 'hex') WHERE $__timeFilter(ash.sample_time) AND ash.work_event_type = 'LOCK' AND ash.workload_type = 'STATEMENT' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY lock_samples DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top 5 SQL — Work Event Profile Over Time
panels.description: Click a series to see full statement detail with work event profile and execution stats.

targets.rawSql: WITH top5 AS (SELECT workload_id, count(*) AS total FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND workload_type = 'STATEMENT' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT date_trunc('second', ash.sample_time) AS time, COALESCE(left(ss.query, 50), left(ash.workload_id, 12)) AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history ash JOIN top5 ON ash.workload_id = top5.workload_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (fingerprint_id) fingerprint_id, metadata->>'query' AS query FROM crdb_internal.statement_statistics ORDER BY fingerprint_id) ss ON ash.workload_id = encode(ss.fingerprint_id, 'hex') WHERE $__timeFilter(ash.sample_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top SQL Statements by ASH Samples
panels.description: Click a row to drill into that statement's work event profile, node distribution, and execution stats.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ash.workload_id AS fingerprint_id, COALESCE(substring(ss.query, 1, 120), 'fingerprint: ' || ash.workload_id) AS query_preview, ash.app_name, count(*) AS total_samples, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ash.work_event_type = 'CPU') AS cpu, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ash.work_event_type = 'IO') AS io, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ash.work_event_type = 'LOCK') AS lock, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ash.work_event_type = 'NETWORK') AS network, round(count(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 1) AS pct FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history ash LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (fingerprint_id) fingerprint_id, metadata->>'query' AS query FROM crdb_internal.statement_statistics ORDER BY fingerprint_id) ss ON ash.workload_id = encode(ss.fingerprint_id, 'hex') WHERE ash.workload_type = 'STATEMENT' AND $__timeFilter(ash.sample_time) GROUP BY ash.workload_id, query_preview, ash.app_name ORDER BY total_samples DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Admission Control Events
panels.description: ADMISSION = CockroachDB flow control. Click to drill into admission detail.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('second', sample_time) AS time, work_event AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND work_event_type = 'ADMISSION' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: System Internals (Raft, GC, etc.)
panels.description: CockroachDB-unique: internal work like Raft consensus, GC, intent resolution

targets.rawSql: SELECT workload_id AS system_task, count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'CPU') AS "CPU", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'IO') AS "IO", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'LOCK') AS "LOCK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'NETWORK') AS "NETWORK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'ADMISSION') AS "ADMISSION", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'OTHER') AS "OTHER" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND workload_type = 'SYSTEM' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Job Workload Analysis
panels.description: BACKUP, IMPORT, schema changes, auto-stats jobs. Click to drill into job detail.

targets.rawSql: SELECT workload_id AS job_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'CPU') AS "CPU", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'IO') AS "IO", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'LOCK') AS "LOCK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'NETWORK') AS "NETWORK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'ADMISSION') AS "ADMISSION", count(*) FILTER (WHERE work_event_type = 'OTHER') AS "OTHER" FROM information_schema.crdb_cluster_active_session_history WHERE $__timeFilter(sample_time) AND workload_type = 'JOB' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 15
